brief.prompt: Original Memlia 3D isometric editorial still life, 16:9 cream #fcfbf7 paper background. A LARGE solid matte graphite #231f20 dark ink sorting tray occupying at least 12 percent of frame, and two clearly visible geometric blocks green #27b657 and deep green #1c8a41. Three blank sheets approach the tray: one aligned, one put aside as a duplicate, one isolated for ambiguous period; beside them an empty open verification gate, no check marks. This is a fictional bookkeeping task selection, not a software user interface. Soft studio light upper left, no people, no words, no logos, no numbers, no automatic approval, no red alerts.
